links.comparator_used: Direct-answer prompting (non-CoT setting) on the same models
links.outcome: Performance on 87 real-world clinical text tasks across 95 LLMs, 9 languages and 8 task types
links.effect: 86.3% of models suffer consistent performance degradation in the CoT setting; more capable models remain relatively robust, while weaker ones suffer substantial declines
links.tradeoff: CoT enhances interpretability but may undermine reliability in clinical text tasks
links.quote: Contrary to prior findings in other domains, we observe that 86.3\% of models suffer consistent performance degradation in the CoT setting.
